section_7_strategy_d.label: CLAUDE_HAND_PROOF for reproduction; CLAUDE_OBSERVATION for assessment
section_7_strategy_d.selection_criterion: sort 13 non-exhausted states by (legal_successor_count ascending, proved_lower_bound ascending, depth descending, node_id), deduplicate by compound key (successor_signature_class_sha256, component_geometry_class_sha256), take first 8
section_7_strategy_d.independent_reproduction: reproduced the exact procedure from raw data; result matches the claimed 8-state batch exactly

key_structural_finding.statement: among the 13 unresolved states, every one already has a distinct compound (successor_signature, component_geometry) profile -- no two of the 13 share a compound profile at all
key_structural_finding.implication: the deduplication step is a no-op on this data; the 8-state batch is not a coverage-preserving compression, it is simply the top 8 of 13 already-fully-distinct states ranked by fewest successors, then tightest proved bridge-distance lower bound, then greatest depth

section_7_strategy_d.excluded_states_pattern: precisely the 5 states with the highest legal_successor_count (2,2,3,3,3) among the 13 -- the batch systematically favors the narrowest states first

representative_heuristic_or_proved.verdict: heuristic, not backed by any proved continuation equivalence
grounds: Codex's own document explicitly disclaims the profiles as non-equivalences
the compound-key dedup is a no-op here, so there is no actual equivalence class being represented at all -- each 'representative' stands only for itself

section_7_strategy_d.assessment_A_all_13: strictly more complete; given the dedup-is-a-no-op finding, not meaningfully more information-costly than the 8-batch in proof-structure terms, only more compute (325000 vs 200000 expansions)
section_7_strategy_d.assessment_B_smaller_proof_oriented_subs: no principled way to pick a smaller provably-representative subset without an actual equivalence relation to justify it -- any subset smaller than 13 is a resource-driven guess exactly as the 8-batch is
section_7_strategy_d.assessment_C_hand_analysis_of_9_closed_s: already fully closed; further hand analysis extracts candidate shared-mechanism material from data already in hand at zero further computation cost -- highest value per unit effort, requires no new search
section_7_strategy_d.assessment_D_deeper_single_hardest_profi: lowest proof value per unit effort -- no coverage or comparative value, no reason to expect faster convergence than breadth
section_7_strategy_d.recommendation: C first (free, uses only existing data), then A over the specific 8-batch if further search is pursued (more complete for comparable effort since no real compression is being exploited), D least justified
section_7_strategy_d.relation_to_codex_own_recommendation: refines rather than contradicts Codex's own D_then_A framing -- Codex's 'D' labels the structural-subfamily strategy (correct that equal effort on all 22 too early is wasteful); this analysis adds that the prioritization achieved is not the coverage-preserving one its description implies
